summary: Cedar Springs Public Library urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate as a permanent, inclusive program that continues to provide substantial savings, maintain eligibility for all libraries, preserve recurring broadband support, avoid increasing administrative burdens, and acknowledge the ongoing digital divide. The letter urges the FCC to preserve the E‑Rate program so that small public libraries can continue to provide reliable broadband connectivity to their communities.
